featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-000-RACK3 is a 7U rack mount that provides a clean installation for up to 8 NetworkHD 600 encoders or decoders. Mounting brackets for all devices as well as the NHD-000-CTL NetworkHD controller are also included allowing for all required devices to be installed in a single location.

Vertical slot installation supports any combination of up to 8 NetworkHD 600 Series components or NHD-000-CTLs providing ideal component heat dissipation and airflow - a key factor in increasing reliability and product lifespan.
All mounting hardware provided: rack, brackets, blanking plates, rails, lacing bar, handles and screws.
Specifically designed for organizing NetworkHD components within the main rack location, the NHD-000-RACK3 de-clutters the rack, improving cable management, port identification and unit access.
7U height and shallow depth allows for high component density in an AV or IT equipment rack
The included removable rear cable management lacing bar helps route cabling at the correct point to optimize thermal efficiency
The included removable front-facing handles greatly improves maneuverability and convenience
Provides optimal thermal dissipation in a passively or actively cooled rack design to maintain premium device performance and MTBF
Enables systems to be pre-built into the rack kit prior to arriving on site to improve speed and efficiency of installation
Sturdy all-steel design creates a solid structure for supporting NetworkHD 600 Series components
Includes 8x 600 Series mounting plates, 1x NHD-000-CTL mounting plate and 4x blanking plates
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
